# t2.1 — Backend Baseline Verification Recovery

## Summary
The reported backend test-classpath failure is not reproducible in the current authoritative backend tree. A clean, full Maven lifecycle run from `giro-app/backend` compiled all 55 main sources and all 3 test sources, ran all 12 tests, and produced the executable Spring Boot JAR successfully.

No production or build-file change was justified: the reported missing symbols are present in `src/main/java/com/giro_app/backend/`, were compiled into `target/classes`, and were available to `testCompile` during verification. The recovery action was a deterministic `clean verify` from the tracked nested backend root, after which the baseline blocker cleared.

## Diagnosis
- Maven project: `giro-app/backend/pom.xml`
- Main compilation: 55 sources, release 17, exit 0
- Test compilation: 3 sources, exit 0
- Main classes named by the prior failure (`SimulationService`, `SimulationAccountRepository`, `SensitiveDataConverter`) exist under the declared package and were resolved by test compilation.
- The earlier symbol failures are consistent with a stale/transient build state rather than a current source/package, POM, or classpath defect.
- Project-root source duplicates were not used; verification remained anchored to tracked `giro-app/backend`.
